data.body: [P2] Allow scheduled callers to reach the cloud job. When an SDK follows the new guide's recommendation to schedule LMI runs, the reusable workflow receives `github.event_name == 'schedule'`, which this condition excludes. The workflow can therefore finish green after only local harness tests without executing any lifecycle requirements. Add `schedule` to the trusted event allowlist while retaining the Dependabot and fork restrictions, and cover scheduled callers in the workflow tests.
